name: MinMaxMedical
description: MinMaxMedical (MMM) is a medical technology company based in Saint-Martin-d'Hères and Apprieu, France. Founded in 2008 by Stéphane Lavallée, MMM conducts R&D in computer-assisted surgery, surgical navigation, and sensors, including the Gemtrack miniature radiofrequency tracking technology acquired by DePuy Synthes / Johnson & Johnson for the VELYS platform. In coordination with the Haventure startup accelerator, MMM develops underlying technologies for early-stage surgical device ventures.
